title: Netdata Alarm Alarm Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=netdata:alarm alarm_value=*
| stats sum(alarm_value) as total_value, avg(alarm_value) as avg_value by chart_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks chart values by total and average alarm value across Netdata alarm events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `alarm_value` values for each Netdata alarm event and review total and average alarm value by chart.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total alarm value.
grandmaExplanation: It will warn which chart shows the biggest alarm value numbers in your Netdata alarm data.
